description: Fetch tweets, replies, timelines, search results, X Lists, and X Articles from X/Twitter without login or API keys. Single tweets: zero dependencies (FxTwitter). Timelines/search/replies: a Nitter instance (XTF_NITTER). Lists: Nitter first, browser fallback. Articles: a browser driver (Camofox or Playwright). Unified JSON schema across all backends; machine-readable error_code for agent branching.
